answer: A copied enrollment photo still lets one farm mint many keys. This gate assigns each applicant one surveyed meadow plot and a serialized kernel that must be planted in a posted orchard row during a 16-minute sunrise window. Three unaffiliated wardens film the shoot emerging and post commit=blake3(addr||plot_id||kernel_serial||row_hash||ts). Planting costs 0.37 POA; 17 POA locks for nine epochs. Peers replay the public tapes and recompute the commit. A reused plot, transplanted kernel, or shared orchard row slashes the bond and benches both keys for fifteen epochs.
